The notice states that there is no application fee for this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Use the application form published on the District and Sessions Court, Ahmednagar website, https://ahmednagar.dcourts.gov.in. The specimens of the certificates to attach are on the same website. Send the application by Speed Post with acknowledgemen to this address: The Registrar, District and Sessions Court, Ahmednagar, Near Nyay Nagar, Behind DSP Office, DSP Chowk, Ahmednagar 414 001 Write (Application for the post of Book Binder) on the envelope. Send it early enough that it reaches the court by 6.00 pm on 4 November 2026. The court will not consider: applications received after 4 November 2026; applications sent by ordinary post; applications delivered by hand; applications whose envelope does not carry the words "पुस्तक बांधणीकार या पदाकरिता अर्ज". Applications that are not in the prescribed form, or that contain incomplete information, will be treated as ineligible. The "Registration Number" (नोंदणी क्रमांक) box on the form is for office use, and the office will fill it in.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Book Binder. One candidate will be placed on the selection list and one on the waiting list. The candidate must have passed the Secondary School Certificate (S.S.C.) examination. The candidate must have passed a course in book binding from an Industrial Training Institute or another equivalent government-recognised institution. The candidate must have technical and professional knowledge of book binding. Minimum: not less than 18 years. General category: not more than 38 years. Backward class: not more than 43 years. Under Government Resolution No. एसआरव्ही-१०७७/३५७६/१४३३/१६-अ dated 23 May 1978, the upper age limit for physically handicapped persons is raised to 45 years. This applies only if they are otherwise eligible and able to perform the duties of the post. A birth certificate, school leaving certificate or SSC examination certificate is mandatory as proof of age. The post is in Pay Level S-5 of the revised pay structure under the 7th Pay Commission: Rs. 18,000–56,900, plus allowances admissible as per rules. Candidates already in government service must get written permission from the head of their department or office before applying. They must produce this permission at the interview. They do not need to send the application through their department or office head. In Form A, candidates declare that they may be disqualified at any stage of the selection process if more than two of their children were born after 28 March 2005. An unmarried applicant writes "not applicable" in the relevant places of that declaration. Form A also covers arrests, pending criminal cases and convictions. Candidates who are state or central government employees also declare that no disciplinary inquiry is pending against them and that they have not been found guilty in one. content_sections.heading: Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be appointed or deputed as Book Binder in any court under the Ahmednagar district judiciary. The duties are: binding books in the court library; binding files, registers and similar records kept in the court; doing all necessary work as directed by the officers. The Book Binder post is a single, isolated post and offers no chance of promotion.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application form ends with a numbered list of the documents attached, which the candidate dates and signs. Do not send a Demand Draft, Pay Order, cheque or any other payment with the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder selection has two stages: a book binding evaluation test and an oral interview. If a large number of applications are received, the selection committee may first shortlist candidates using suitable criteria. The committee's decision is final, and no objection to the shortlist will be considered. Candidates will take an evaluation test of book binding work worth 20 marks. Selection is strictly by merit, using the combined marks of the evaluation test and the oral interview. The selection committee reserves the right to prepare the shortlist and to make any necessary changes. The names of shortlisted candidates will be published on the District Court, Ahmednagar website and notice board. The identity card format will be uploaded to the website at the same time. Download the identity card format, fill it in properly and paste on it the latest passport-size photograph (the one sent with the application). Sign the identity card in black ink in the space given, submit it to the District Court on the dates given, and collect the admit card. Candidates without the admit card will not be allowed to take the evaluation test or the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Book Binder post for the selection list and 01 place on the waiting list.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District and Sessions Court, Ahmednagar by 6.00 pm on 4 November 2026. Applications received after that date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Book Binder post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC and a book binding course from an ITI or another equivalent government-recognised institution. They must also have technical and professional knowledge of book binding.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder post?
faq.answer: On 20 October 2026, candidates must be at least 18 years old. The upper limit is 38 years for the general category and 43 years for backward class candidates. For physically handicapped persons, the upper limit is raised to 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Level S-5 under the 7th Pay Commission (Rs. 18,000–56,900), plus allowances admissible as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the recruitment is completely free and that no Demand Draft, Pay Order or cheque should be sent with the application.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder post?
faq.answer: Fill in the form from https://ahmednagar.dcourts.gov.in and attach Form A, Form B and the other documents. Send it by Speed Post with acknowledgement to the Registrar, District and Sessions Court, Ahmednagar, Near Nyay Nagar, Behind DSP Office, DSP Chowk, Ahmednagar 414 001, with "पुस्तक बांधणीकार या पदाकरिता अर्ज" written on the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Book Binder post?
faq.answer: Candidates take a book binding evaluation test (20 marks), followed by an oral interview (20 marks) for candidates at three times the number of posts. Final selection is by merit on the combined marks.

faq.question: Q9. Can I send the application by hand or by ordinary post?
faq.answer: No. The court will not consider applications delivered by hand or sent by ordinary post. Only Speed Post with acknowledgement is accepted.

faq.question: Q10. Is there promotion in the Book Binder post?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the Book Binder post is a single, isolated post with no chance of promotion.
